scope: Actual physical first8 -> causal fill/FIT normalize -> fixed NumPy E -> local observed-past LS and implemented diagnostics; no F yet

fitted_local_metadata.cutoff_scope: Observed-subset centered latent slope matrix only; analytic intercept is unpenalized and is not part of the cutoff
fitted_local_metadata.intercept_rule: Per-window/channel observed mean raw C minus observed mean latent K dot slope
fitted_local_metadata.minimum_norm_coordinate_scope: Truncated minimum-norm LS inside retained centered-latent singular directions; not unrestricted full-design LS or minimum norm of uncentered augmented [Z,1] coefficients
fitted_local_metadata.normal_equation_certificate_scope: Residual orthogonal to retained singular directions only; discarded nonzero directions can leave a nonzero full-design residual gradient
fitted_local_metadata.regularization_scope: No ridge penalty or threshold search; fixed hard relative SVD truncation 1e-4
fitted_local_metadata.no_observation_fallback_rule: D column exactly zero; reconstruction bias=current C; forecast=current C; no global fallback or future optimality claim
fitted_local_metadata.gain_scope: Relative condition cap is not an absolute D norm or future-error bound; local singular scale, raw target scale and forecast delta matter
fitted_local_metadata.past_target_scope: Only true observed C past responses; causal-filled inputs remain in the unchanged cached E representation
fitted_local_metadata.decoder_interface: K future streams + current C + origin-specific KxC coefficients fitted from all-C known past and observation masks
fitted_local_metadata.zero_delta_anchor_scope: Exact FP32 numeric value for zero delta; arithmetic addition need not preserve signed-zero bits
